source_notes.label: Hydrothermal precursor and postannealed oxide
source_notes.summary: Hydrothermal processing first produces orthorhombic InOOH. Annealing at 500 °C for 1 h in normal atmosphere gives rhombohedral In2O3. Separate records preserve the intermediate and final phases with explicit parent-record lineage; these are stages of two vessel routes, not four unrelated physical batches.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental synthesis; Figure 1 and second-vessel comparison

source_notes.label: Two vessels with different reported detail
source_notes.summary: The first experiment uses a stirred 300 mL stainless-steel pressure vessel, 0.7 M aqueous indium nitrate monohydrate, 200 °C and 4 h. The second uses a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave without stirring. The source calls its filtration, washing and drying similar to the first case; its hydrothermal concentration, temperature and dwell are not independently restated. Vessel capacities do not establish liquid charges.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1, Experimental synthesis paragraph

source_notes.label: Reference cells are not specimen refinements
source_notes.summary: For orthorhombic InOOH, cited reference values are a = 5.260 Å, b = 4.560 Å and c = 3.270 Å; the first hydrothermal specimen refines to 5.262, 4.591 and 3.258 Å. For rhombohedral In2O3, reference a = 5.487 Å and c = 14.510 Å differ from the first annealed specimen values 5.469 and 14.491 Å. Only the refined specimen values enter product measurements. No atomic coordinates are supplied.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1, XRD phase indexing and lattice refinements

source_notes.label: XRD sizes and TEM have distinct evidence
source_notes.summary: The annealed stainless-steel route has a Scherrer mean of 12 nm and reported range 10–18 nm. The continuing XRD comparison gives a mean of 22 nm and range 19–26 nm for the annealed Teflon-lined route. These are author-reported size estimates, not newly counted TEM distributions. Figure 2a qualitatively confirms nanometer particles only for the stainless-steel route; its 100 nm scale bar is not a particle diameter.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, Scherrer estimate, second-vessel comparison and Figure 2

source_notes.label: Stirring is an interpretation, not an isolated causal test
source_notes.summary: The authors attribute the size difference to stirring effects. The experiments also use different vessel capacities and liner materials, and not every second-experiment condition is restated. The attribution is retained as the authors’ interpretation without treating it as a controlled one-variable law.

source_notes.label: Phase evidence and application motivation
source_notes.summary: Figure 1b indexes rhombohedral In2O3, R-3c (167), ASTM 22-336. The authors report no detectable XRD peaks from other indium compounds; this does not establish an absolute chemical-purity limit. Figure 2b supports rhombohedral diffraction for the first annealed specimen. Introductory conductivity and sensing claims refer to background literature, not measurements on these powders.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, Introduction, phase analysis and TEM/SAED discussion
